The page omits this hypothesis; the paper reaches arbitrary widths and shapes only after padding rows (Lemma at line 1631). As stated, the recursion for width mu^d is claimed for any array.

gaps.quote: The shear is such an invocation, with $D$ as $X$ and $H$ as $Y$, so it is exact for any initial auxiliary contents.
gaps.note: X, Y are banks of scalars indexed by triples, while H, D are address fields of an array. The page never says how the address shear on role streams is a forward invocation, or why exactness for scratch wires gives exactness for scratch rows. The paper gets this from the frame identity and the row split (lines 1520-1532), not by identifying the shear with an invocation.
